result.stdout:
Description:
  Converts an input SVG image to an application icon with specified format.

Usage:
  dotnet-icons convert <in> [<out>] [options]

Arguments:
  <in>   A source SVG file name.
  <out>  A destination file name. If not specified, the source file name is used with a appropriate extension depending on the output format.

Options:
  -f, --out-format <out-format>  An output application icon format. Must be one of: 'win-ico', 'macos-icns', 'ios-png-set', 'android-png-set'.
  -?, -h, --help                 Show help and usage information
